actual_scope: Prove the exact deterministic adaptive oracle query cost 1+n+binom(n,2) for affine native tag membership in the promised quadratic Z/4 phase class.
scope_change_reason: The card suggests formalizing or auditing an existing implication. This contribution instead proves a new sharp membership lemma and constructs optimal tests and indistinguishable impostors, without auditing a predecessor or using a proof assistant.

stop_rule: Stop after the first proved membership bound with a matching construction and bounded exact verifier; do not extend to physical pricing or tensor sums.
